name: yahtzee
title: Yahtzee
description: Solo Yahtzee: five dice, three rolls a round, thirteen rounds, with the card showing what every category would score. Play with the mouse or one-handed on the arrow keys; your game in progress, best score and average are kept.
author: pal

store.tagline: Solo Yahtzee with the scores in plain sight, by mouse or keys
features: The scorecard shows what each open category would score with the dice as they lie
One-handed: the arrows pick and hold dice, `space` rolls, `↓` jumps to the best category, `enter` scores
The upper bonus as a bar toward 63, greyed once it is out of reach
Hasbro's rules in full, including Yahtzee bonuses and the Joker rules
Dice that tumble, confetti for a Yahtzee, and the final score beside your best and average
Leave any time and pick the game up again, even after a restart

screenshots.caption: Mid-round: three fours kept, each open box showing what it would score
Out of throws: the cursor on the card, the dice it counts ringed, the total showing what it adds
A second Yahtzee: 100 more, and as a Joker it fills a straight
Game over: the final score with the best and the average
